set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-research.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Optional follow-on after G1 and temporal queries; not a 1.0 requirement for annotation-only/AV mapping, temporal inspection or raw-BIDS crosswalk.

Remaining / next action: Implement optional evidence-backed within-event localization with fail-coarse/mass-conserving output and explicit uncalibrated status; qualify synthetic narrow/broad/multiple-occurrence cases before a separate frozen reliability study.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Governing plan: docs/plans/2026-09-22-recall-encoding-workflow.md; ADR 0019. Repository: storymodel4s.

Scope: align, features, media, codec, tools/recall-study

Acceptance criteria:
1. Refine plausible source events using admitted time-anchored annotation/dialogue/ASR/visual evidence and the existing provider-feature contracts. Retain coarse event mass and its residual when no finer evidence exists; unsupported refinements return a broad or unavailable localization.
2. Separate localization of a particular occurrence from event extent and genuine multi-event summaries. Return alternative disjoint regions and occurrence IDs. Candidate coverage, truncation and residual coarse mass remain inspectable.
3. A finer candidate partition with unchanged information/prior cannot create confidence. Declare prior/base measure and evidence selection; do not turn repeated frames or duplicated captions into independent evidence. Source/recall and retrieval information use are receipted.
4. Synthetic exact-evidence, contradictory-evidence, repeated-occurrence and no-fine-evidence controls demonstrate fail-coarse behavior, mass conservation and no invented precision. Bind new kernels to mapping/evidence/projection identities and expose them through the existing CLI/exchange/Atlas contract.
5. Ship the engineering result as explicitly uncalibrated. Existing reliability ticket bd-01M2TAEW794XCR7D2HZJFNXVJY owns separate continuous-event validation and calibration; the legacy within-scene human packet is diagnostic only. Broad summaries are valid outputs and are not forced to a point gold label.

Boundary: Optional follow-on. Does not gate annotation-only mapping, AV sidecar consumption, temporal inspection or the raw-BIDS crosswalk. Scientific qualification is separate from engineering completion.

Implementation evidence: exact baseline/result revisions, bound commands/test totals/exit, artifact digests, independent known answers, one failing mutation with an accepting control per guarantee, compatibility impact and separate cold review. StoryModel uses tools/reference-scope.sh and clean exact-revision sbt -batch checkAll. Proposed suites are acceptance specifications until implemented. No held-out corpus read, hosted spend, recruitment, publication or calibration is authorized by this engineering ticket.
